faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.subtitle: Something you can't find here? Write to us at noreply.reqsai@gmail.com

items.q: How does ReqsAI work during a meeting?
items.a: You record from the browser: in a virtual meeting you share the tab's audio, and in person you use the microphone. ReqsAI transcribes live, tells speakers apart and proposes new stories, changes, edge cases and questions to clarify. You decide each suggestion: approve it, save it as a draft or dismiss it.

items.q: Is my data safe? How are organizations isolated?
items.a: Each organization has its own database schema, separate from the others. We do not use your content to train models. ReqsAI reads your repositories with read-only permission, and stores neither the code nor credentials. The details are in the Privacy Policy.

items.q: Do I need to install any software or plugin?
items.a: No. ReqsAI runs in the browser. For a virtual meeting you share the audio of the tab where it happens, and for a past meeting you upload the recording from the capture menu.

items.q: Which tools does ReqsAI integrate with?
items.a: Jira Cloud: connect one or several sites with Atlassian (or an API token), pick the project and issue type, send stories with their acceptance criteria and import existing ones. And GitHub, through a read-only app the copilot uses to understand the client's code.

items.q: Can I analyze recordings of earlier meetings?
items.a: Yes. Upload the recording from the capture menu and ReqsAI transcribes it in the session's language and generates the stories. Uploading a recording counts against your monthly AI allowance.

items.q: Can I trust what the AI generates?
items.a: The AI can be wrong, so no story is taken as good on its own. Each suggestion comes with the client's quote, you can edit it before accepting it and, with the code connected, verify it against what is implemented. You approve, save as draft or dismiss.

items.q: Which languages does it work in?
items.a: You choose the language of each session, and transcription and analysis happen in it. The platform is available in Spanish and English.

items.q: What happens when the monthly AI allowance runs out?
items.a: Each plan includes a monthly token allowance: 100,000 on Starter, 2 million on Pro and 50 million on Enterprise. You can see usage in Settings → Usage, with warnings at 80, 90 and 100%. At the cap suggestions and chat pause, but you can keep recording, transcribing, reading, editing and exporting.

items.q: Do I need a card to start?
items.a: No. When you sign up your organization starts on the free Starter plan, no card. When you need more members, AI tokens or context documents, upgrade to Pro or Enterprise from Billing and pay with Stripe. If you go back to Starter, you keep your data.
